race.comment: PORTLAND (7) underrated stayer well suited back to Listed grade and the jump in trip. Far from disgraced at WFA with a close-up sixth to Lindermann over 1800m in the G2 Craven Plate at this track last Saturday. Adept in all conditions and has solid winning claims. STARZINTHEIREYES (9) close up in all three runs this prep and won't know himself with the 54kg. Ticks plenty of boxes and expect to see him a touch closer in the run. Genuine contender. ANTHRACITE (10) comes here deep into the campaign having won three of his last four starts. Dropped back to the mile last Saturday when he gripped on to win the Filante at this track. Will be in this for a long way. BARRENGARRY (14) deserves his chance here on the limit. keep safe.
